test_title: RRB ALP CBT-II (Mechanic Diesel) Official Paper (Held On: 06 May, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Single plate friction clutch has clutch disc between ______.

options.text: Differential gears and transmission gear boxes

solution:
The correct answer is __Flywheel and Pressure Plate**(Option 4)**.__

**__Key Points__**

__
 
• A single plate friction clutch is a mechanical device used to transmit power.
 
• The clutch disc is positioned between the flywheel and pressure plate.
 
• It engages and disengages power transmission from the engine to the transmission system.
 
• It consists of friction material that provides the necessary grip for efficient power transfer.
 
• Single plate clutches are commonly used in cars and light vehicles.
 
• This type of clutch is simple in design and offers smooth operation.
 
• Proper maintenance ensures long-lasting performance and reliability.

**Additional Information__**

 
• **Driving Shaft:**

 
 
• It connects the clutch to the gearbox.
 
• Responsible for transmitting torque from the engine.
 
 
 
• **Pressure Plate:**
 
 
• The pressure plate applies force on the clutch disc.
 
• Ensures engagement of the clutch for power transfer.
 
 
 
• **Flywheel:**
 
 
• It is attached to the engine crankshaft.
 
• Stores rotational energy and assists in smooth engine operation.
